findings.subject: S1

findings.message: B0: holding declarations need hold.stop, hold.grip_mm, coolant, deburr_mm.

hold.clamp: Clamp the raw bar in the bench vise for the initial cutoff; retain the kept bar and arrange the offcut safely.
hold.note: BEFORE LOADING: use calipers to measure and record the actual slot throat width and wide undercut width. Measure undercut depth using the source's backstop against the underside of the slot lip; identify the reference surfaces. Check the intended rod with a matching 3/8-16 nut, not the misleading M10 x 1.5 near-fit. Establish approved nut targets/clearances so it will slide, pull up under the lips and stay below the table. Then establish safe blade engagement, raw-bar cutoff length and offcut support. HOLD while any prerequisite is unknown.

findings.subject: B0

findings.message: B1: holding declarations need hold.stop, hold.grip_mm, coolant, deburr_mm.

hold.clamp: Support the nut in the vise for the punch operation as shown, with the bottom thread accessible.
hold.note: Support the part against the punch load without damaging the bearing shoulders or distorting the usable upper threads. Exact support and punch deformation remain unspecified.

findings.subject: B1

findings.message: B2: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

hold.note: HOLD: confirm the actual JAX product label/SDS, chemical-compatible container, ventilation, splash protection, solvent/fire precautions and waste handling before starting. Chemical gloves belong only in this stopped-machine chemical task, never near a rotating spindle. Establish a complete chemical-safety procedure before starting.

findings.subject: B2

findings.message: C1: holding declarations need hold.stop, hold.grip_mm, coolant, deburr_mm, stock_state.top_z, stock_state.bottom_z.

hold.clamp: Stand the profiled bar on end and grip its lower portion securely in the vise; keep the horizontal cut above the jaws.
hold.note: HOLD: establish the actual upright grip, safe support of the upper cut-off, and full disk/arbor/jaw clearance. Never catch the top piece or reach toward a running saw; stop fully before retrieval.

findings.subject: C1

findings.message: C2: holding declarations need hold.stop, hold.grip_mm, coolant, deburr_mm, stock_state.top_z, stock_state.bottom_z.

hold.clamp: Grip the short upright remainder at the vise end. Place an already-separated nut at the opposite jaw end; add paper with the piece being cut so it is held slightly tighter.
hold.jaw_protection: Paper is between the cutting workpiece and jaw, not on the balancing nut; thickness/contact unmeasured.
hold.note: HOLD: do not run until work and offcut retention, balanced jaw contact and complete saw/arbor/jaw clearance are established. Do not catch the cut-off; stop fully before retrieving it.

findings.subject: C2

findings.message: D1: holding declarations need hold.grip_mm, deburr_mm, stock_state.top_z, stock_state.bottom_z.

hold.clamp: Seat and clamp the nut for centre drilling, through drilling and guided hand tapping.
hold.note: HOLD: establish tap-drill diameter, drilling depth including point, complete under-work breakout clearance, tap/follower reach and engagement. Do not drill into parallels/vise. No gloves near a rotating spindle; stop the spindle for manual tapping.
hold.stop: Seat each finished nut to the same repeatable stop.

findings.subject: D1

findings.message: E1: holding declarations need hold.grip_mm, coolant, deburr_mm, stock_state.top_z, stock_state.bottom_z.

hold.clamp: Clamp at the left vise end with the end to be milled overhanging BOTH jaws and any support. Seat the opposite end against the stop.
hold.note: HOLD: establish the overhang and full-depth cutter clearance past both jaws and supports. Stop attachment, grip and seating remain unmeasured. No gloves near a rotating spindle.
hold.stop: Rod stop from the right locates the opposite retained end; keep the left cutting end free.

findings.subject: E1

findings.message: F1: holding and cutting decisions are declared; this does not approve measured fixture clearance.

hold.note: Mill stopped: use the actual table slot and intended stud/workpiece. Do not use a nut that rocks, jams, stands proud, lacks shoulder support or lets the stud reach the table bottom.

findings.subject: F1

findings.message: Q1: holding declarations need hold.stop, hold.grip_mm, coolant, deburr_mm, stock_state.top_z, stock_state.bottom_z, hold.align.indicator, hold.align.limit_mm, hold.align.over_mm.

hold.clamp: Hold the raw bar securely in the vise for a cleanup skim.
hold.note: HOLD: establish actual jaw contact and raw-stock position; measure cutter projection and check jaw clearance before spindle start. These remain unmeasured. No gloves near a rotating spindle.

findings.subject: Q1

findings.message: Q2: holding declarations need hold.stop, hold.grip_mm, coolant, deburr_mm, stock_state.top_z, stock_state.bottom_z.

hold.clamp: Before loading, establish the fixed-jaw Y0 pickup. Then place the first machined face against that jaw, use the round bar at the moving jaw, and seat and clamp the bar.
hold.note: HOLD: round-bar diameter/length, seating, vise alignment, engagement and cutter clearance are unmeasured. Establish secure round-bar contact before cutting.

findings.subject: Q2

findings.message: Q3: holding declarations need hold.stop, hold.grip_mm, coolant, deburr_mm, stock_state.top_z, stock_state.bottom_z.

hold.clamp: Before loading, establish the fixed-jaw Y0 pickup. Then seat the previously machined 90-degree corner at the lower fixed-jaw side and clamp.
hold.note: HOLD: establish actual seating, jaw engagement, clearance and approved acceptance limits. Nominal base width is 22.225 mm; actual slot-fit clearance remains unmeasured.

findings.subject: Q3

findings.message: Q4: holding declarations need hold.stop, hold.grip_mm, coolant, deburr_mm, stock_state.top_z, stock_state.bottom_z.

hold.clamp: Seat the squared corner and support the bar on parallels; clamp securely.
hold.note: HOLD: measure parallel height and grip, and check cutter/jaw clearance before cutting; these remain unmeasured. Nominal overall height is 12.7 mm. Keep the head close and the quill mostly retracted and locked for each pass; lock the unused axis on heavy cuts. No gloves at a rotating spindle.

findings.subject: Q4

findings.message: S1: holding declarations need hold.stop, hold.grip_mm, deburr_mm, stock_state.top_z, stock_state.bottom_z.

hold.clamp: Select parallel height so enough stock projects above the jaws for both shoulders while preserving positive jaw engagement; seat and clamp.
hold.note: HOLD before spindle start: measure actual grip, shoulder depth, cutter/flute reach, holder projection and jaw clearance throughout both passes. No gloves near a rotating spindle.
